dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed according to Arcadia project Methodology (Report: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA”). LCA study of electricity consumption from Italian electric mix (Report: “Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano”). The dataset refers to the consumption of 1 kWh of electricity from electrical mix in high voltage, in Italy, and it is representative of the processing technologies commonly used for this purpose. The dataset consists of 6 processes: 1) Electricity production from the Italian high-voltage electricity mix (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 86,5%). 2) Electricity imported from France (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 4,7%). 3) Electricity imported from Switzerland (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 6,8%). 4) Electricity imported from Austria (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 0,4%). 5) Electricity imported from Slovenia (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 1,6%). 6) High voltage electricity transmission network.

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription:
Gabriella Fiorentino, Simona Scalbi, Antonietta Cerbone, Giuliana Ansanelli, Marco Giammartini, Amalia Zucaro. Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano.
Background datasets from EcoInvent database cut-off (v.3.7.1) were used for the LCA study.

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: This dataset has been considered valid until 2026, since no main changes have occurred in the electricity mix in Italy in the investigated years

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: The dataset refers to a system that includes domestic electricity production for consumption (primary data - TERNA), and the share received from abroad (from France, Switzerland, Austria and Slovenia) (primary data - TERNA). The system also includes the length of the electricity transmission grid (primary data - TERNA), and network and transmission losses of high-voltage lines are taken into account (primary data from Regulatory Authority for Energy Networks and Environment - ARERA). For the LCA study, background datasets from EcoInvent database 3.7.1 cut-off were used.
technology.technologicalApplicability: Electricity from Italian electricity mix sold to the Italian electric grid.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system

referenceToDataSource.common:shortDescription: 20231031171129_Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano.pdf

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Metodology: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” and ISO 14040-44 norms. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. Each dataset has been evaluated based on the following 4 criteria: 1. Technological Representativeness; 2. Time Representativeness; 3. Geographical Representativeness; 4. Reliability (A) In this context, the Reliability is very good.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology.
